title: Derived internal Hom from a pseudo-coherent module preserves bounded-below quasi-coherence
statement: Let $Y$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-algebra which is pseudo-coherent as an $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], and let $K$ be an object of $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Then $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(A,K)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], with its natural $A$-module structure [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module], belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(A)$ [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra]; after forgetting the $A$-module structure it belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$.

proof.text: By [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], every point of $Y$ has an open neighbourhood on which $A$ is quasi-isomorphic to a bounded-above complex of finite free modules; shrinking to affine opens and using that the Noetherian scheme $Y$ is quasi-compact, choose a finite affine open cover $Y=\bigcup_{i=1}^n U_i$, $U_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$, with $A|_{U_i}$ quasi-isomorphic to a bounded-above complex $\mathcal F_i^\bullet$ of finite free $\mathcal O_{U_i}$-modules. Restriction to an open commutes with derived internal Hom by [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-restrict-open]. The same restriction functor is exact by [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact], so cohomology sheaves restrict as well, and $K|_{U_i}$ lies in $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(U_i)$ with the same lower bound $a$ as $K$.

source.place: Tag 0A6H, proof of clause (1), localization to affine opens

proof.text: On $U_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ a map $\mathcal O_{U_i}^m\to\mathcal O_{U_i}^k$ is a matrix over $\Gamma(U_i,\mathcal O_{U_i})=R_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], so $\mathcal F_i^\bullet=\widetilde P_i$ for a bounded-above complex $P_i$ of finite free $R_i$-modules. By the affine equivalence [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence], $K|_{U_i}\cong\widetilde L_i$ with $L_i=R\Gamma(U_i,K|_{U_i})\in D(R_i)$; since $M\mapsto\widetilde M$ is exact and $\Gamma(U_i,\widetilde M)=M$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], $H^q(L_i)=0$ for $q<a$. The affine comparison [lem-sc-affine-pseudo-coherent-rhom-qcoherent] identifies $R\mathcal Hom(A,K)|_{U_i}$ with the associated sheaf of $R\operatorname{Hom}_{R_i}(P_i,L_i)$, whose cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent and vanish in sufficiently negative degrees. Taking the minimum of these finitely many bounds, the cohomology sheaves of $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(A,K)$ are quasi-coherent and vanish in all sufficiently negative degrees.

source.place: Tag 0A6H, clause (1) reduced to clause (3) on an affine

proof.text: The action of $A$ on the first argument gives the natural $A$-module structure through [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module]. By the definition of $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(A)$ in [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra], quasi-coherence for an $A$-module is quasi-coherence of its underlying $\mathcal O_Y$-module. Thus the object lies in $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(A)$ and, after restriction of scalars, in $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$.
